page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, 8.0 GB of system memory providing 4.0 GB per core, and no local storage or bundled GPUs. The CPU cache configuration consists of a 32 KB L1d cache, a 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.n2.medium operates in the lower tiers of performance. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is 1107.09, which sits in the bottom 25 percent, while the multi-core score drops to 2193.58, placing it in the bottom 10 percent. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with read-only small block cached bandwidth at 157.12 GB/sec and large block uncached read and write speeds falling to 16.61 GB/sec and 14.38 GB/sec respectively. Passmark metrics reflect similar trends, with a CPU score of 2641.62 and a database operations score of 553.1, both in the bottom 10 percent.

The instance lacks local storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external block storage attachment. While it features dedicated CPU allocation and supports instruction sets like AVX and AVX512F, its overall processing and memory throughput are weak compared to modern hardware profiles. This makes it a qualitatively entry-level option for workloads with low resource demands. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic Redis caching with moderate throughput requirements, and simple administrative tasks rather than intensive database operations or high-throughput data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 8.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, this instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Benchmark data indicates entry-level performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU metrics placing in the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth is similarly constrained, with uncached large-block read speeds at 16.61 GB/sec. The instance supports AVX and AVX512F instructions but lacks advanced cryptographic acceleration like SHA-NI. Given these performance characteristics, the ecs.n2.medium is best suited for low-intensity workloads such as basic web serving, lightweight application hosting, and minor background tasks where dedicated CPU allocation is required but high computational throughput is not critical.
